// diagnostic E0115

Jet.LoopControlOutsideLoop

`break`/`next` outside a loop

What

`break`/`next` outside a loop

Why

`break` and `next` steer the nearest enclosing loop, and here there is none

Fix

Use `break` or `next` only inside a loop.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning Jet.LoopControlOutsideLoop: Tests/UI/break_outside_loop.stderr.

Error: Jet.LoopControlOutsideLoop: `break` only works inside a loop
  --> Tests/UI/break_outside_loop.jet:1:13
    |
  1 | run: fn() { break }
    |             ^^^^^
 Why: `break` and `next` steer the nearest `loop` loop
 Fix: Move this inside a loop, or remove it
